intro.h2: Pick the slab, not a picture of it
paragraphs: Melling Granite & More makes custom granite countertops in Cedar City, and you choose the stone in person. Walk into the shop on Westview Drive, look at the actual slabs and pick the one that goes in your kitchen or bath. As one customer put it, you are not expected to make a choice by looking at a picture.

The team specializes in custom natural stone and quartz tops for kitchens and baths, from a single vanity to every stone surface in a whole-house remodel. Reviewers say they get the specifics right up front, do not cut corners and are meticulous from the office to the install crew.

items.name: Granite kitchen countertops
items.blurb: Granite counters and islands cut to your layout, including bold slabs with heavy movement and chiseled edges. Customers choose their granite at the shop during their visit and the Melling crew handles fabrication and installation.

items.name: Natural stone tops
items.blurb: Natural stone tops with dramatic veining for kitchens that want a showpiece. Melissa, a Melling project manager, helped one homeowner find the perfect slabs for a whole-house remodel, including the white and green veined top on a long walnut island.

image.alt: Long walnut island with white and green veined natural stone top under white ribbed pendant lights

items.name: Quartz countertops
items.blurb: Quartz tops for kitchens and baths, part of the shop's focus on custom natural stone and quartz counters. Ask about details such as Bocci plugs, the sleek modern outlets the shop has shown next to a regular plug.

items.name: Stone for baths and showers

about.text: Melling Granite & More is owned by Corri and Mark Melling and runs from a shop at 260 N Westview Drive in Cedar City. Their slogan, The Natural Choice, sums up the focus: custom natural stone and quartz countertops for kitchens and baths. The team includes project manager Melissa, Ginger at the front desk and an install crew that reviewers praise by name. The shop is part of the community too. During its 12 Workdays of Christmas giveaway, people could bring canned food to the shop for extra entries.

image.alt: Melling Granite shop front on Westview Drive in Cedar City, with a gold and black sign over glass doors and flower planters

steps.title: Visit the shop
steps.text: Stop by 260 N Westview Dr, Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM, or call (435) 867-0099 to talk about your kitchen or bath.

steps.title: Choose your slab in person
steps.text: Look at the real granite, quartz and natural stone slabs and pick yours on the spot, with help from the project manager.

steps.title: Settle the details
steps.text: The team gets the specifics right up front, from edges to sinks and outlets, so there are no surprises later.

steps.title: Fabrication and install
steps.text: The Melling install crew sets your new countertops. Reviewers mention the crew's attention to detail, promptness and clean work.

items.name: Sue S.
items.text: We used Melling for all of our stone work in a whole-house remodel.  Their craftsmanship is beyond compare.  Melissa was our project manager, and she went above and beyond to find the perfect slabs for our project.  Great customer-oriented company and meticulous at what they do.  We absolutely recommend them and would use them again if we ever needed stone work.

items.name: Jennifer O.
items.text: We had a great experience from the moment we went into the office until the granite was installed. We were able to select our granite at the same time as our visit and weren't expected to make a choice by looking at a picture. I would highly recommend Melling Granite & More for any project, large or small.

items.name: Nikole G.
items.text: I have worked in the countertop industry and I won’t take my business anywhere else! Great attention to detail. They get all of the specifics upfront so you don’t have issues later down the line. They don’t cut corners which is so important when it comes to a high dollar item like countertops. Everyone on their crew is amazing from Ginger at the front line to their install crew and owners! Thank you Melling Granite! We love our counters.

service_area.h2: Granite countertops for Cedar City homes
service_area.text: Melling Granite & More is based at 260 N Westview Dr in Cedar City, Utah, where customers come to see slabs and talk through their project. Cedar City is home for the shop and its Facebook page. If your home is outside town, call (435) 867-0099 with your location and project to ask whether the install crew can reach you, or email the owners.

items.q: Can I see the slab before I buy?
items.a: Yes. Customers choose their granite during their visit to the shop instead of picking from a photo. The owners say selecting stone in person is an important part of the process, and project managers like Melissa help you find the right slabs for your space.

items.q: What materials do you work with?
items.a: Melling specializes in custom natural stone and quartz countertops for kitchens and baths. Past projects include granite islands, veined natural stone tops, stone shower walls and a carved stone range hood surround. Call or visit to see what is in the shop now.

items.q: Do you handle bathrooms or only kitchens?
items.a: Both. The shop focuses on countertops for kitchens and baths, and one customer used Melling for all the stone in a whole-house remodel, including a walk-in shower lined with large stone slabs. Bring your bathroom measurements or plans when you visit.

The shop is open Monday to Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can call (435) 867-0099 during those hours or email corri@mellinggranite.com to ask a question or plan a visit to look at slabs.

items.q: Can you add outlets or other details in the stone?
items.a: Ask during your visit. The shop has shown Bocci plugs, a sleek, modern outlet, side by side with a regular plug on its Facebook page. Reviewers say Melling settles all the specifics up front, so details like outlets and sinks are planned before cutting.

final_cta.text: See the slabs in person at the Westview Drive shop, Monday to Friday.
